p.src: The Bank of England’s explainer on money creation remains one of the clearest official public summaries of the modern process: most money in the economy is created by commercial banks when they make loans. That alone clears up a common misunderstanding. Banks do not simply lend out pre-existing piles of household deposits in a mechanical way. Lending creates deposits.
